title: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order, 2020
fineness: Gold jewellery and gold artefacts covered by the applicable BIS standard
geographical_applicability: District-based applicability established through subsequent amendments; principal order created the mandatory framework
amendment: Principal order establishing mandatory hallmarking framework
exemption: Articles meant for export to foreign buyers according to specifications; articles weighing less than 2 g; articles consigned from outside India to recognized A&H centres for hallmarking; articles intended for medical, dental, veterinary, scientific or industrial purposes; gold thread; articles not substantially complete and intended for further manufacture; gold bullion in specified bar/plate/sheet/foil/rod/wire/strip/tube/coin forms
qco_supersession: Continues as principal order, subject to all subsequent amendments
